description: Markets covered, company counts, history depth per market, the companies that answer with full history without a licence key (full_history_sample), the metric vocabulary, the source attributions that must travel with the data, and the licence the data is supplied under (for a time-limited key, its terms and end date). compact (true) leaves out the per-market notes and accounting descriptions. Emissions Data, a separate dataset that is not one of these markets (greenhouse gas and related figures from public registers, by company number or facility ID), is read with get_emissions_sources, get_emissions and match_emissions_ids, for an API key whose licence includes it.

compact.description: true leaves out the long per-market notes (market_notes, schema) to save tokens; default false
